_comment: Copy to expectations.local.json (git-ignored) and point it at one of your own captures. The suites assert on real content, which is why these values are not committed.

singleTurn.user: the prompt text of that turn
singleTurn.thoughtWithContent: a summary whose thought has non-empty content
singleTurn.finalContains: a distinctive phrase from the middle or end
singleTurn.finalEndsWith: the exact tail, private-use citation delimiters included
